meta.name: containing-active-breach
meta.description: Executes containment strategies to stop active adversary operations and prevent lateral movement during a confirmed security breach. Implements short-term and long-term containment using network segmentation, endpoint isolation, credential revocation, and access control modifications. Activates for requests involving breach containment, lateral movement prevention, network isolation, active threat containment, or live incident response.

copy.tagline: 阻止活跃攻击者在网络内横向移动
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在处理已确认的安全入侵并需要立即遏制
copy.tagline_en: Stop active attackers from moving laterally in your network
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are handling a confirmed security breach and need immediate containment

howto.what: 当确认发生安全入侵时，Claude 会执行遏制策略，包括网络隔离、端点隔离、撤销凭证和修改访问控制，以阻止攻击者横向移动。
howto.when: 当用户请求处理活跃的入侵、横向移动、网络隔离或实时事件响应时触发。

say.text: 我们检测到勒索软件正在通过SMB传播，请立即遏制。
say.note: Claude 会执行短期遏制，如隔离端点、禁用账户。

say.text: 发现一个被入侵的域管理员账户，请撤销其凭证。
say.note: Claude 会禁用该账户并重置密码。

say.text: 请对受感染主机进行网络隔离并阻止C2通信。
say.note: Claude 会执行网络遏制和C2阻断。

howto.what_en: When a confirmed security breach is in progress, Claude executes containment strategies including network segmentation, endpoint isolation, credential revocation, and access control modifications to stop adversary lateral movement.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests actions related to active breach containment, lateral movement prevention, network isolation, or live incident response.

say_en.text: We detected ransomware spreading via SMB, please contain it immediately.
A compromised domain admin account was found, please revoke its credentials.
say_en.note: Claude will disable the account and reset its password.

say_en.text: Please isolate the compromised hosts and block C2 communication.
say_en.note: Claude will perform network containment and C2 blocking.
